messages:
ashley: FYI main CI started failing after the clang toolchain bump rolled last night. macOS link errors across multiple targets :eyes:
ci-bot: buildkite.com/redwood/ci#1234 failed (macos-release, bazel build) - https://ci.example.com/builds/1234
ashley: Example error from the macOS worker:
```
/usr/bin/ld: undefined symbol: _ZN3std3...
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
Target //libs/net:net_bin failed to build
```
raj: can you paste the failing target list? im trying a quick local repro on darwin VM
ashley: //libs/net:net_bin, //libs/proto:proto_lib, //apps/agent:agent_mac - all linking against libstdc++/c++abi variants
maria: this smells like the toolchain's libstdc++ or -stdlib= settings changed. last roll bumped clang from 15 -> 16 and switched libc++ build flags.
kevin: i saw a similar break earlier when we accidentally switched the release image to include a custom libstdc++; CI job 1201 had a note. Might be the same root cause.
dana: @ci-bot can we rerun only the macos-release matrix? want to ensure it's deterministic before bisecting.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by dana: re-running pipeline macos-release (job 1234)
ci-bot: re-run finished: still failing (macos-release)
raj: ok repro'ed locally in `darwin-latest` docker. stack trace shows mismatched symbol versions. Quick bisect plan: bisect the toolchain roll range -> if suspect commit identified, roll back image.
ashley: timeline: toolchain roll merged yesterday at 21:12 UTC (commit ab12cd3) and image build/tag updated at 23:00 (image: infra/clang-toolchain:2026-03-16).
maria: steps I'd try: 1) confirm target link flags (`bazel build //libs/net:net_bin --sandbox_debug`) 2) check `clang -v` and `ld -v` inside macos builder 3) try `bazel build --config=macos --remote_download_toplevel` locally
kevin: I can run a quick bisect. plan: checkout previous image tag `infra/clang-toolchain:2026-03-15`, run CI job matrix locally, then step forward commits in the roll PR. if we find the commit that introduced different shipped libstdc++ artifacts we can revert.
dana: another option: add an interim fallback policy in CI to pin to previous image until fix, but that's heavier. prefer narrow rollback.
raj: i'm starting the bisect now. command i'm using:
```
# on infra/clang-toolchain repo
git bisect start ab12cd3 ab00ef0
# run the image build/test script and then a macos smoke bazel build
./scripts/build-image && ./scripts/run-macos-smoke.sh
```
raj: will update here with the first bad commit in ~30m
ashley: thanks. if you find the commit ping platform@ and i'll open the rollback PR immediately. also creating a short alert in #incidents so PMs are aware. :exclamation:
maria: if bisect stalls ping me, i can repro on a clean mac mini in office. might be quicker to confirm the symbol differences with `nm` on the shipped libs.
ci-bot: @raj reported progress: bisect step 4/12 - still failing
raj: bisect narrowed it to two commits touching libc++ build flags: commit d4e9f2 (enable LTO in libc++) and e6b1a7 (update prebuilt libstdc++ packaging). suspecting the packaging one.
kevin: great find. can you try building the image with d4e9f2 reverted locally? that should tell us if LTO caused the symbol changes.
raj: building with e6b1a7 reverted now, will push a test image to staging in ~10m
ashley: if reverting e6b1a7 fixes, i'll coordinate a rollback of the image tag and a hotfix to packaging.
ci-bot: staging image pushed: infra/clang-toolchain:staging-179500 - triggered smoke CI
ci-bot: staging smoke CI: success
raj: confirmed: staging image with e6b1a7 reverted builds macOS bazel targets successfully. that isolates the regression to the packaging commit.
maria: ok rollback it is. ashley can you file rollback PR and coordinate with release to re-tag image?
ashley: filing PR now and pinging release. PR: https://git.example.com/infra/clang-toolchain/pulls/987 - includes revert and changelog.
kevin: after rollback we should add a test: `nm -g` check on packaged libstdc++ to verify symbol versions match expected baseline before promoting image.
dana: agreed. also add the staging smoke gate to the daily roll process so we don't promote regressed packaging.
ashley: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with postmortem once rollback is live. :thumbsup:
